## 📁 Website Structure

```
csxia-website/
│
├── 📄 index.html              ← Complete single-file website
│
├── 🖼️ csxia-logo.png          ← Official CSXIA logo
│
└── 📂 team/
    ├── 🧑 abu-bakar.png       ← Founder photo
    ├── 🧑 rishabh.png         ← Co-Founder photo
    ├── 🧑 farhan.png          ← Branding Ambassador photo
    ├── 🧑 sogra.png           ← Ops Lead photo
    └── 🧑 abdullah.png        ← Tech Media Head photo
```

**Tech used:**
![HTML5](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-E34F26?style=flat-square&logo=html5&logoColor=white)
![CSS3](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS3-1572B6?style=flat-square&logo=css3&logoColor=white)
![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-F7DF1E?style=flat-square&logo=javascript&logoColor=black)
![GitHub Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub_Pages-222222?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)

**Features:**
- ✅ Anti-gravity scroll animations (Intersection Observer API)
- ✅ Custom cursor with blend-mode effect
- ✅ Animated floating particles
- ✅ Live builder counter animation
- ✅ Sticky nav with blur on scroll
- ✅ Floating "Join Now" CTA
- ✅ Fully responsive (mobile + desktop)
- ✅ All WhatsApp, Instagram & LinkedIn links live
- ✅ Zero dependencies — pure HTML/CSS/JS
